title: E-FRC-0263: one photon off one charged register member, read on the husk, partial: exact conservation gives the...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0263 in the gauge arena: one photon off one charged register member, read on the husk, partial: exact conservation gives the Compton shift lambda_C (1 - cos theta) at low energy with lambda_C set by the member's inertia (1 / R of the standard on one speed, R = tan m / m), departing as $k^2$ at finite k; the low-frequency amplitude is Thomson's with the inertia in place of the rest mass (sigma / sigma_T = $1 / R^2$), and below the pair threshold the dipole response is Dirac's; the finite-k cross section and the absolute value (alpha) are not run.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
